Baby für TV-Produktion gesucht

**Gedreht wird in Köln: Gesucht wird ein Baby, das im September 2026 maximal 4 Monate alt ist.**

Selbstverständlich werden alle Einsätze vergütet. Das Wohl der Kinder hat für uns oberste Priorität. Während der Dreharbeiten ist unter anderem eine Hebamme am Set und die Eltern sind selbstverständlich jederzeit bei ihrem Kind.

Bei Interesse oder Fragen schreibt mir gerne eine PN oder DM. Ich freue mich auf eure Nachricht!

Betreff: Suche nach einer Wochenend-Camera-Acting-Ausbildung
Hallo,

ich suche im Raum Baden-Württemberg eine 3-monatige Camera-Acting-Ausbildung oder einen Screen-Acting-Workshop, der nur samstags und sonntags stattfindet.

Ich arbeite derzeit im Zwei-Schicht-Betrieb, deshalb kann ich nur am Wochenende teilnehmen.

Mein Budget beträgt bis 350 €.

Ich bin Anfänger und suche einen Kurs für Anfänger als Hobby, um die Grundlagen des Camera Actings zu lernen und erste Erfahrungen vor der Kamera zu sammeln.

Falls Sie einen passenden Kurs anbieten, freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Nachricht.

Vielen Dank!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Rembo Lakatos

**Darsteller gesucht – erwachsener Fußballer ca. 35-45 Jahre alt**

Für einen Dreh beim **TSV Herrsching am Ammersee** suchen wir einen sympathischen, sportlichen Mann, der sicher und authentisch vor der Kamera sprechen kann.

**Termin:** 09:00 bis ca. 14:00 Uhr inkl. Pause
**Drehort:** TSV Herrsching e. V., Jahnstraße 14, 82211 Herrsching am Ammersee
**Gage:** 250 €

Du solltest Fußball spielen können und nicht kompletter Anfänger sein. Wichtig sind außerdem ein selbstbewusstes, natürliches Auftreten und Freude daran, direkt in die Kamera zu sprechen.

Ideal wäre, wenn du aus der Umgebung kommst oder keine allzu weite Anreise hast.

Bitte schick uns bei Interesse ein aktuelles Foto, ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo

## **CASTING | KRAKÓW 4.08 – Aktor (Interviewer)**

Hej! Szukam aktora do roli Interviewera w 15-minutowym filmie szkoleniowym z zakresu cyberbezpieczeństwa (szkolenie LMS dla korporacji).
* 📍 **Lokalizacja:** Kraków (szukamy osób z Krakowa – brak zwrotu kosztów dojazdu)
*  📅 **Termin:** 1 dzień zdjęciowy – 4 sierpnia (godz. 8:00–20:00)
* 💰 **Stawka:** 1500 zł netto (pełny wykup / buyout: perpetual, worldwide, all media) - bez widocznego wizerunku

**Kogo szukamy?**
* Mężczyzna (ok. 30–40 lat).
* Rola bez wizerunku – ujęcia wyłącznie zza pleców / zza ramienia.
* Biegły angielski (C1/C2) oraz świetna dykcja i praca głosem – warunek konieczny!
* Doświadczenie przed kamerą / praca na planie.

**Jak się zgłosić?**
* Wyślij maila na: **jankoczur.casting@gmail.com**
* **Temat:** Casting – Interviewer – Imię i nazwisko
* **W treści dołącz:** Imię, wiek, wzrost, miasto, nr telefonu. 2-3 aktualne zdjęcia (twarz + sylwetka). Krótkie demo/self-tape w j. angielskim lub próbka głosu (min. 30 sekund – tekst dowolny). Link do portfolio/showreela (jeśli masz).

Czekam na Wasze zgłoszenia! 😊

**WARSZAWA **

**serial fabularny - STAND INI **

**stawka: 160 zł**

Do serialu fabularnego szukam STAND INA i STAND INKI.

**Stand in** to osoba zastępująca aktora podczas przygotowań technicznych takich jak np. ustawianie oświetlenia czy kadrowanie kamer.
* **STAND IN'KA** - kobieta ok. 20-35 lat, wzrost ok. 166 cm, rozmiar XS, włosy dłuższe ciemny blond.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

* **STAND IN **- mężczyzna ok. 20-40 lat, wzrost ok. 183 cm, klatka ok.104 cm, rozmiar L, brunet, włosy dłuższe. Nie długie. Klasyczna fryzura.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3, 6, 8, 10 i 11 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **STAND IN**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość i wymiary: wzrost, klatka/biust, pas, rozmiar ubrania i buta

W załączniku: **zdjęcie twarzy - selfie z dnia zgłoszenia i aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki**

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka.

items.text:
**POSZUKIWANI STATYŚCI NA PLAN**

Do filmu dyplomowego studentki Warszawskiej Szkoły Filmowej poszukujemy kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku** 40-65 lat**.

📅 Termin: **4-5 sierpnia** (udział w jednym z dni, data do ustalenia)

📍 Miejsce: **Warszawa**

Ze względu na to, że jest to projekt studencki, udział jest **non-profit**, natomiast zapewniamy transport, wyżywienie na planie oraz miłą atmosferę.

Kilka słów o twórcach:

Poprzedni film reżyserki Agaty Kapuścińskiej i autora zdjęć Mateusza Gzela —„Nibylandex” — był prezentowany m.in. na Krakowskim Festiwalu Filmowym, Festiwalu Polskich Filmów Fabularnych w Gdyni oraz EnergaCAMERIMAGE, a także na trzech festiwalach kwalifikujących do Oscara. Wierzymy, że „Futuria” również ma szansę dotrzeć do szerokiej publiczności i odnieść podobny sukces.

📩 Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział lub znasz kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany – napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Będzie nam bardzo miło, jeśli dołączysz do naszej ekipy!

Serdeczne pozdrowienia,

Ekipa filmu ,,FUTURIA”

items.text:
PROJECT INDIA
Lokacja zdjęć: Warszawa 

 Ilość dni zdjęciowych: 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe (w zależności od roli) - 18-19 sierpnia 🎬🎥✅

 Prawa / Usage Rights: 1 rok 

 Terytorium emisji: INDIE (Brak emisji w Polsce / Europie / UK)

 Pola eksploatacji: TV, Digital, Internet, Social Media

ROLE GŁÓWNE (HERO ROLES) — 1 000 USD / dzień z prawami 

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. REŻYSER (THE DIRECTOR) — 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 40–60 lat (typ indyjsko-brytyjski lub europejski).

 Opis: Prawdziwy twórca kinowy, lekko niewyspany, charakterystyczny.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego, wyczucie aktorskie)

2. NARZECZONY (ROMANTIC LEAD) [Gra mimiką]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Charyzmatyczny, ciepły, bardzo męski, dojrzały urok.

 Wymagania: Świetna gra emocjami i mimiką.

KATEGORIA 2: ROLE DRUGOPLANOWE  — 700 USD / dzień z prawami

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. 1st AD (1-szy Asystent Reżysera) 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–45 lat.

 Opis: Dynamiczny, głośny, ekspresyjny. Komediowy wykrzyk "CUT!". 

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

2. OPERATOR (CAMERAMAN) —

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–50 lat.

 Opis: Członek ekipy filmowej z krótką kwestią.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

3. OFIARA (VICTIM) — Scena Zombie [Gra ekspresyjna]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Bohater sceny z zombie. Świetny warsztat komediowo-dramatyczny (krzyk, przerażenie, zmiana emocji na zdziwienie).

4.HERO ZOMBIE [Praca ciałem / Plastyka]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Główny zombie. Bardzo wysoka sprawność fizyczna, doskonała plastyka ciała i ekspresja ruchu.

👥 KATEGORIA 3: Mini EPISODES & BG CREW/Extras  — 200 USD / dzień

(Możliwy 1 -2 dzień zdjęciowy lub krótka sesja skanowania 3D)

1. ZAŁOGA PUSTYNI / MAD MAX CREW (3 osoby)

 Wiek / Płeć: 1 Kobieta, 2 Mężczyzn (25–40 lat).

 Opis: Stylistyka Mad Max / Dune. Ostre, surowe, charakterne rysy twarzy.

2. ZAŁOGA KOSMICZNA (BRIDGE CREW )

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Elegancja, chłodny dystyngowany wygląd.

3. EKIPA TECHNICZNA  (Producent, Focus Puller, Charakteryzator itp.)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–50 lat.

 Opis: Aktorzy / epizodyści potrafiący grać w stylu deadpan (bezemocjonalna, obojętna reakcja na chaos wokół).

4. ZOMBIE EXTRAS (4–6 osób)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Statyści sceny zombie. Wymagana dobra sprawność fizyczna, swoboda w pracy z profesjonalną charakteryzacją oraz ekspresyjna gra ciałem/ruchem.

Część epizodystów/extras z grup (np. załoga statku, technicy) nie będzie obecna na planie przez cały czas. Zostaną oni jedynie odskanowani w 3D, a ich wizerunek zostanie zintegrowany z wideo przy użyciu Sztucznej Inteligencji (AI) wyłącznie na potrzeby tego konkretnego spotu reklamowego.

Wszyscy kandydaci muszą wyrazić pisemną zgodę na skanowanie 3D oraz wykorzystanie ich wizerunku w AI (wyłącznie dla tego projektu).

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA / JAK APLIKOWAĆ:

Prosimy o nadsyłanie zgłoszeń na adres: tatianamakhdi@gmail.com

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: PROJECT INDIA - [NAZWA ROLI] - [IMIĘ I NAZWISKO]

Wymagane materiały:

1. Aktualne zdjęcia: Twarz + Sylwetka

2. Wymiary / Wzrost.

3. Wizytówka wideo po angielsku (obowiązkowo dla ról z kwestiami mówionymi: Director, 1st AD, Cameraman, Producer i td.)

4.Telefon

items.text:
**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

items.text:
Casting Call- VICTORIA
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - Victoria. 

Description: 

Woman; 18 to 27 years old; Eastern European/ White or Mediterranean. Victoria is a young Russian woman desperately trying to escape a dangerous life tied to the criminal underworld. After witnessing a brutal retaliatory mob attack on her friend, she is left deeply traumatized, and forced into hiding. 

Must be able to speak fluent Russian and English. The role requires strong emotional depth, and vulnerability.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (1) to happen during week of Aug 9. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

Woman; 18 to 27 years old; Eastern European/ White or Mediterranean. Victoria is a young Russian woman desperately trying to escape a dangerous life tied to the criminal underworld. After witnessing a brutal retaliatory mob attack on her friend, she is left deeply traumatized, and forced into hiding. 

Must be able to speak fluent Russian and English. The role requires strong emotional depth, and vulnerability.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (1) to happen during week of Aug 9. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

🎬 CASTING CALL – “Forever, Summer” (Volunteer Short Film)

Hey everyone! ❤️

I’m so excited to share that we’ve officially started casting for my passion project, Forever, Summer, a romantic drama short film that will be filmed in Metro Vancouver this September.

We’re currently casting:

🎭 Hunter (Lead)
• Playing age: 23 (Actors 19+)
• Open to all ethnicities

🎭 Ryan (Supporting)
• Playing age: 27 (Actors 23+)
• White or Hispanic preferred, with dark hair and dark eyes to reflect a believable family resemblance.

📍 Must be able to work locally in Metro Vancouver.
📅 Must be available between September 4–7, 2026.

This is a volunteer project, and all cast members will receive:
• IMDb credit
• Professional footage for their demo reel
• Meals on set
• An invitation to attend film festival screenings if the film is officially selected

To submit, please email which character do you want to audition, your headshot, resume and demo reel (if you have one) to foreversummer.casting@gmail.com  by August 9. Selected actors will receive audition sides.

Thank you so much!!

"Girls, Insecure, Sex and the City, but more raw, more real"

Short-film Logline: A romantic dramedy exploring modern dating, identity and self-worth, seen from the eyes of an immigrant woman navigating a chaotic night that shifts from illusion to reality.

CASTING FOR ONE MORE ACTOR! PAID ROLE

Juan. Age range: 30's, male, Latin/Mexican ethnicity, with a Spanish accent

Juan is charismatic, confident, impulsive, and impossible to ignore.bHe moves through the world with ease, charm, and a reckless sense of freedom, but beneath his playful exterior is a man who avoids vulnerability.

Note: Actor must be comfortable performing intimacy on camera, kissing scenes.

SUBMISSIONS & AUDITION DETAILS

Please send your resume, photos (full body + headshots) and demo reel (if available) by email to lesimmigrantsparty@gmail.com ASAP

Auditions in Gastown this Saturday, August 1st!!!

Location: Vancouver, BC

Shoot Dates: August 21st-23rd, 2026, rehearsals prior

Compensation: Paid/TBD/Indie Micro-Budget, IMDb Credit, meals provided

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email your headshot, resume and demo reel (if available) to lesimmigrantsparty@gmail.com

CASTING CALL- Victoria
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - Victoria. 

Description: 

Woman; 18 to 27 years old; Eastern European/ White or Mediterranean. Victoria is a young Russian woman desperately trying to escape a dangerous life tied to the criminal underworld. After witnessing a brutal retaliatory mob attack on her friend, she is left deeply traumatized, and forced into hiding. 

Must be able to speak fluent Russian and English. The role requires strong emotional depth, and vulnerability.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (1) to happen during week of Aug 9. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

In episode 46 of Beyond Reel Talk podcast, I'm joined by casting director Nicole Ricciardi from Ricciardi Casting for a long and practical conversation about how casting really works and what every actor should know.

We talk about what happens behind the scenes after an audition, how casting decisions are made, who really has the final say, why actors hear nothing after auditions, whether social media affects castability, the impact of AI on casting, and the biggest mistakes actors make without realising it.

In the second half of the episode, Nicole reviews my own Spotlight profile live, explaining what works, what doesn't, and how casting directors actually look at headshots, showreels, skills, playing age and credits.

Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

1. Kamil (24) – agresywny socjopata i patologiczny kłamca z przeszłością w poprawczaku, mocno zadłużony. Silny, na dopalaczach, bezwzględne spojrzenie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY 
Daty: 10.08 i 11.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

2. Adrian (27) – Interesuje się strzelectwem, jest instruktorem na strzelnicy. Zostaje postrzelony przez kolegę, gdy próbuje obezwładnić go podczas włamania.
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Dominik (28) – prowadzi spółkę zajmującą się kompleksowym montażem nowoczesnych instalacji elektrycznych, alarmów i monitoringu. Zostaje pobity. Średniej budowy ciała, nie jest silny fizycznie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4. Pracownik 2 (28) – pracownik budowlany
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

5. Sebastian (30) – prowadzi komis, karany w przeszłości za kradzieże. Skupuje kradziony sprzęt.
Data: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

6. Pracownik 1 (37) – pracownik budowlany 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

7. Konrad (39) – brat Artura. Nieporadny, z bardzo niską samooceną, wiecznie gnębiony przez brata i niedoceniany przez rodziców. Przez całe życie gromadził w sobie żal i gniew. Wysoki, szczupły, dłuższe włosy.
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Daty: 12.08 i 14.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

8. Biznesmen (45) – elegancko ubrany mężczyzna, zostaje napadnięty na ulicy. 
Daty: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9. Właściciel (48) – przedsiębiorca budowlany. Zawiadamia policję o zaginięciu pracowników i pomaga w identyfikacji. 
Daty: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Waking Dreams is a psychological thriller feature film.

We are currently looking for an actor or performer for an experimental mixed-media project exploring the limitations and perceptions of gender and the body.

**Performer requirements:**
* Open to actors and performers of any gender
* Must be aged 18 or over
* Must be available for both of the following sessions:

   * One weekday during the first two weeks of August, from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., at Queen’s University Belfast campus

The director will provide further information about the project after initial contact.

If you know anyone who might be interested, we would really appreciate it if you could share this casting call with them.

Best wishes,
Dara

items.text:
K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review
* Casting interview
* Self-tape audition
* Character discussions and project briefing
* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops
* Sessions with experienced acting coaches
* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives
* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub
* Refreshments and facilities provided
* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

How to Apply?

Please email or DM your application including:

* Headshot
* Full Name
* Telephone Number
* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

Email: Ahmedsy_jaber@hotmail.com

Serious Applicants Only!

We are moving quickly with this project and are looking for committed, reliable and professional actors who are genuinely interested in becoming part of a long-term television production.

If you know someone who would be suitable, please share this casting opportunity.

items.text:
Flashback Friday 🎬

A long time ago...

Back to Alina im Wunderland.

A film about a film crew, where I had the pleasure of working with Arkadij Khaet and Mickey Paatzsch, long before their acclaimed series Chabos brought them wider recognition.

And yes… I got to play the arrogant director. 😄

Sometimes the most enjoyable roles are the ones that lovingly make fun of our own business.

Looking back, it was an unforgettable ride.

—

actor • film • theatre

🫶🏻 Stay safe & positive

#FlashbackFriday #ActorsLife #FilmActor #BehindTheScenes #GermanCinema

Flashback Friday 🎬

A long time ago...

Back to Alina im Wunderland.

A film about a film crew, where I had the pleasure of working with Arkadij Khaet and Mickey Paatzsch, long before their acclaimed series Chabos brought them wider recognition.

And yes… I got to play the arrogant director. 😄

Sometimes the most enjoyable roles are the ones that lovingly make fun of our own business.

Looking back, it was an unforgettable ride.

—

actor • film • theatre

🫶🏻 Stay safe & positive

#FlashbackFriday #ActorsLife #FilmActor #BehindTheScenes #GermanCinema

✨ Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here. ✨

Hi, I’m Megan May Parsons, and this is the beginning of a journey I’ve dreamed about for a long time.

Writing The Cost of Applause has been more than creating a book it’s been a way of sharing a story about chasing dreams, facing self-doubt, finding resilience, and learning that your worth is never defined by applause.

If you’ve ever felt like you weren’t enough, questioned your path, or fought to keep going, I hope this story reminds you that you are not alone.

Over the coming weeks, this book will be ready to purchase and ready to be read by new people. I can’t wait to bring you along.

Thank you for being here from the very beginning. Your support means more than you know. ❤️

Welcome to the world of “The Cost of Applause.” 🎭📖

🌿 15 Gentle Reminders for a Peaceful Life 🌿

The deepest truths are often the simplest. Slow down, reflect, and let these words settle into your heart.

✨ Peace is not found in a quiet place, but in a quiet presence.

✨ What you cling to eventually owns you.

✨ The ego seeks validation. The soul seeks freedom.

✨ Freedom begins where resistance ends.

✨ True compassion leaves no room for enemies.

✨ You often suffer less from what happens than from the story you tell yourself about it.

✨ Don’t detach from life—detach from the illusions that keep you from living it fully.

✨ Stillness is where wisdom speaks.

✨ Comparison steals your peace more than it steals your joy.

✨ Forgiveness doesn’t excuse the past—it frees your heart from carrying it.

✨ Constant craving can blind you to the beauty of what you already have.

✨ Awareness is the beginning of healing.

✨ When you let go of the need to always be right, you make room to grow.

✨ Wisdom begins where the need to control ends.

✨ Happiness isn’t something you chase—it’s something you return to when you come home to yourself.

Life becomes lighter when you release what weighs your spirit down and embrace what brings peace to your soul.

✨ The greatest journey isn’t to become someone new—it’s to rediscover the peace that has always lived within you.

#InnerPeace #Mindfulness #Wisdom #SelfAwareness #PersonalGrowth #Healing #LivePresent #Gratitude #LetGo #Compassion #Forgiveness #ChoosePeace #SpiritualGrowth #MentalWellbeing #SoulJourney

**Hiring: Writer-Directors for ReelShow**

Hi everyon. My name is Ethan and I'm the project manager handling hiring for ReelShow. We're a brand new studio building original microdramas and micro series using AI-driven production tools.

We're looking for writer-directors to join our core content team. Each episode runs 70–80 seconds, part of a contained series with a clear beginning, middle, and end. You'll take a script and own it from page to screen by working alongside a small team of AI creators and editors to bring it to life.

What we're looking for:
* Experience writing and producing preferred
* Directing background — film school or equivalent hands-on experience
* Comfort working in a fast-moving, experimental production pipeline
* Based in or able to work with our Hollywood team (remote considered)

This starts as a paid trial period (5–6 weeks) with the opportunity to join the core team if it's a good fit.

If you or someone you know writes and directs and wants in on the ground floor of this, send a reel/samples my way — [17archere@gmail.com](mailto:17archere@gmail.com).

**CASTING CALL – FEATURE FILM "BINGO, NOT DEAD YET!"**

Catalina De La Cruz Studios is officially casting for our upcoming independent feature film, **BINGO, NOT DEAD YET!**

**Project Details**
* **Location:** Metro Atlanta, Georgia
* **Compensation:** Deferred compensation (contingent upon funds raised)
* **Additional Benefits:** On-screen credit, meals provided on set, copy of footage for your acting reel, IMDb credit, and festival exposure
* **Project:** Independent Feature Film

We're looking for talented actors to bring the residents and staff of Sunnyside Senior Living to life!

**LEAD ROLES**

**James Sullivan** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Mac Callahan** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**SUPPORTING ROLES**

**Debbie Sullivan** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Vinny Moretti** – Male, playing age 50–80 (Italian preferred; Italian American and/or New Jersey accent preferred)

**Kitty** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Harold White** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Raj Patel** – Male, playing age 50–80 (South Asian; South Asian accent)

**Raymond "Ray J." Jackson** – Male, playing age 50–80 (Black/African American)

**Vivienne Beaumont** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Eleanor Briggs** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Patricia "Patty" Miller** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Leticia Harris** – Female, playing age 25–45 (Black/African American)

**Valerie Torres** – Female, playing age 22–35 (Latina preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Young James Sullivan** – Male, playing age 18–25 (White)

**Young Mac Callahan** – Male, playing age 18–25 (White)

**Young Debbie Sullivan** – Female, playing age 18–25 (White)

**BACKGROUND ROLES**

**Residents** – Male & Female, playing age 50–80

**Staff** – CNAs, nurses, dining staff, maintenance, reception, and visitors, playing age 18–65

Actors of **all experience levels** are encouraged to submit. Whether you're a seasoned performer or just getting started, we'd love to see your audition.

Know someone who would be perfect for one of these roles? Tag them in the comments or share this post!

Character breakdowns, audition sides, and the submission form are available through the **Casting** tab at the link below.

We look forward to seeing your submissions!

**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

La Compagnie Les Ours de Laine ouvre ses portes à des artistes du mouvement : danseurs·ses, circassien·nes, acrobates, cascadeurs·ses, mimes, marionnettistes, interprètes de théâtre physique… et toutes celles et ceux qui aiment raconter par le corps et donner de la voix.

Une matinée de recherche, de training, de partage et de rencontres, en vue de nos prochaines créations et celles en cours.

📍 Paris – début septembre 2026
📩 Candidatures jusqu'au 27 août 2026 (CV + vidéo de présentation ou bande-démo).

➡️ théâtre.physique.contemporain@gmail.com

Si cette annonce peut parler à quelqu'un de votre entourage, n'hésitez pas à la partager. 🌿

Que tu sois débutant(e), amateur(trice) ou déjà semi-professionnel(le), cette association est ouverte à toutes les personnes qui ont envie de créer ensemble.

Notre objectif ? Réaliser un court-métrage collectif, de l'écriture jusqu'à la post-production, puis le présenter en festival.

Au-delà du film, c'est aussi l'occasion de :

Rencontrer des personnes passionnées et motivées.

Développer tes compétences sur un projet concret.

Apprendre en pratiquant et en échangeant avec les autres.

Vivre une véritable aventure humaine et créative.

Que tu sois intéressé(e) par la réalisation, le scénario, l'image, le son, le jeu d'acteur, le montage ou simplement curieux(se) de découvrir les coulisses d'un tournage, il y a une place pour toi.

Si cette aventure te parle, n'hésite pas à me contacter par mail ou par téléphone, je serai ravi d'échanger avec toi !

Contact : 06 52 76 68 19

Mail : lesfilmsdargenteuil@gmail.com

Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/les.films.dargenteuil

Hey friends!! Come bash with us!!!

You might be asking, who is this party for? It's for you!!! 

This (and all CFVA events) are for all prodution artists as well as the community at large! Yes, people who are involved in screen, stage, film, television, commercial, industrial, immersive, podcast, web, vertical, music, comedy, improv, dance - all cast and crew from PA to EP from background talent to principal players - but also anyone who has ever been curious about the media and preforming arts in Colorado! We welcome everyone! 

CFVA SUMMER BASH

Join us for the CFVA Summer Bash, Colorado's can't-miss summer networking event for the film, television, video, and digital media community! Whether you're behind the camera, in front of it, or making the magic happen behind the scenes, this is your chance to connect with fellow creatives in a fun, relaxed setting. Come connect with the community, listen and bop to the sounds of our amazing DJ Tom Giesen! Enjoy the delicious fare of our incredible food trucks: Smoke Ring Romantics BBQ (there will be vegetarian options!), Sassy Sips Dirty Sodas and Jay's Philadelphia Wooder Ice!!! 

Sunday, August 2, 2026

4:00 p.m.

Buntport Theater Company

Denver, CO 80204

WHY ATTEND?

Expand Your Network

Meet filmmakers, producers, directors, editors, writers, actors, agents, crew members, content creators, and industry professionals from across Colorado.

Discover New Collaborations

Whether you're looking for your next project, your next client, or your next creative partner, Summer Bash is the perfect place to start the conversation.

Strengthen the Colorado Film Community

Build meaningful relationships, share ideas, and help grow a stronger, more connected production community throughout the state.

Celebrate the Industry

Take a break from production schedules and enjoy an afternoon with the people who make Colorado's production industry thrive.

Accessibility

This venue is ADA accessible. If you have an accommodation need, please reach out to CFVA's Disability Integration Coordinator, Shirl Garcia. 

Need help with your ticket? We want everyone to join! Just reach out to us at admin@cfva.com for a coupon code.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS

Free Admission for Members, $10 for guests! 

Are you with the Colorado Theater Guild? Reach out to admin@cfva.com for a code to access free admission. We're bridging the gap between screen and stage artists!

Food Trucks On Site – Grab dinner or a snack from a selection of local food trucks offering a variety of delicious options for purchase.

Indoor/outdoor Venue – Stay cool and comfortable inside the unique Buntport Theater or hang outside and engage in shenanigans

Networking & Community – Make new connections, reconnect with familiar faces, and celebrate Colorado's vibrant film and media industry.

Whether you're a longtime CFVA member, new to the industry, or simply curious about Colorado's creative community, the CFVA Summer Bash is a welcoming opportunity to meet new people, exchange ideas, and build relationships that can lead to future collaborations.

Register today and join us on August 2 for an afternoon of community, conversation, and connection. We can't wait to see you at the Summer Bash!

Sun Aug 2 2026, 4:00pm - 7:00pm MDT

**CASTING EXTRAS:  **

We're casting speaking roles and background extras for a DMV comedy shoot. If you love playing larger-than-life characters, this one's for you.

**DENVER DMV** is set inside the most delightfully dysfunctional government office in Denver, Colorado.Filmed in the spirit of “The Office” and “Parks & Recreation”, the series follows a quirky cast scrambling to save their jobs as their branch faces shutdown. 

**FILMING INFO:**

**Saturday 8/1:**  Time TBD but it will be a 3 hour window and maybe less.

**Compensation:**  non paid

**Location: ** Near downtown Denver

**Submissions due by:**  Wed. 7/29 EOD

**Production Company:**  Neato Pictures

**SEND SUBMISSIONS TO: ** **[martinalmaio@gmail.com](mailto:martinalmaio@gmail.com)**** and brandy@neatopictures.com**

****Be sure to include your name, phone number, email and availability on 8/1

**SPEAKING ROLES: ***(Please submit photo and video audition)*

***The Shirtless Renewal Guy (M, 20s-30s)*** — Just wants his new license photo to really capture his best self. Confidence: 100%. Shirt: optional (in his mind).

***Distracted Mom (F, 20s-30s)*** — Rambunctious young son  in tow, phone in hand, mom is anywhere but here. Bonus points if you can ignore chaos with total conviction.

***Rambunctious Young Son (M, 3-6)***** **— Toy hammer, zero chill, and a personal mission to bop every stranger in line.

***The Fed-Up Customer (F, 30s-50s)*** — Been waiting forever, gotten nothing but attitude, and is done being polite about it. Spicy, sharp-tongued, no patience left to give.

***The Vanity Plate Customer (F, 20s-40s)*** — Just wants her perfect vanity plate and cannot fathom why the DMV is making this so hard.

***The Cool Customer (M, 19-30)***** **— Charming, a little sly, and very confident he can talk the clerk into approving a plate that should absolutely not be approved.

**Background Extras** (photo submission only)

Everyday DMV customers: the patient ones, the annoyed ones, the ones glued to their phones, and the ones who make you wonder "what's their story?" We want real faces and real energy.

items.text:
AFFÄRE ODER BEZIEHUNG? EIN DATE, DAS PLÖTZLICH KIPPT

Zwei Darsteller. Drei Locations. Keine vorgegebenen Antworten.

Was passiert, wenn ein scheinbar entspanntes Date plötzlich eine Richtung nimmt, mit der einer von beiden nicht gerechnet hat?

Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße treffen in einer improvisierten Filmszene aufeinander. Ausgangspunkt ist ein gemeinsames Date in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen. Doch irgendwann fällt der entscheidende Satz: Einer von beiden will keine monogame Beziehung, sondern nur eine Affäre.

Improvisation statt auswendig gelernter Dialoge

Wie reagiert das Gegenüber? Enttäuschung, Verständnis, Wut oder vielleicht sogar Zustimmung? Genau das entsteht spontan vor der Kamera.

Gedreht wurde an drei markanten Orten im Kölner Rheinauhafen: in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen, vor dem Schokoladenmuseum und am Kölner Riesenrad. Das Riesenrad steht aktuell direkt am Schokoladenmuseum.

Das vollständige Video mit Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße erscheint bald. Folge uns und entscheide selbst: Affäre oder Beziehung, wie würdest Du reagieren?

#Schauspiel #Improvisation #Darsteller #Köln #Filmproduktion

items.text:
Henry Travers…. was 66 years old when Hollywood gave him the role that would make him immortal.

For decades Travers worked steadily on stage….appeared in 100+ films…. playing doctors, judges, priests, kindly older gents…

By mid-1940s… he was an aging character actor…..then Frank Capra offered him a role unlike anything he played before in…”A Wonderful Life”/1946….

Many assumed the film would be forgotten. Then in 1970s, the copyright expired and TV stations across the country played the film at Christmas.
His simple reminder..…”No man is a failure who has friends”……became one of the most endearing messages in American film history.

An angel….Clarence…..on a snowy bridge…became one of the most cherished moments in film history.

A beacon of hope…..teaching audiences that every life has infinite worth….

Took Henry Travers 80 years to become an overnight success.

#henrytravers #characteractor #itsawonderfullife #clarencetheangel #jimmystewart

LIVERPOOL CASTING: FEMALE PRESENTERS / STREAMERS / UGC CREATORS
📍 Our studio is based in Birkenhead

This is flexible work with the opportunity to earn great commission on days with strong sales.

We are mainly looking for women who are confident and comfortable speaking on camera. Everything else can be learned on the job 😊

Each shift is 5 hours, including a 1 hour break.

Pay: £90 + 3.2% sales commission per shift.

For example, if you generate £2,000 in sales during your shift:

£90 + (£2,000 × 3.2%) = £154 total pay

Sales typically range between £1,000 and £3,000 depending on the day, engagement and performance, meaning there is great potential to increase your earnings through commission.

Previous live-streaming experience is not required.

If you’re interested, please DM us on Instagram with:

• Your photos

• A short speaking video — this can be UGC-style content, acting footage, presenting footage, or simply a short introduction video!

Agency Instagram:  @missimmanagement

Casting Update:
Thank you to everyone who submitted auditions and showed interest in The Whistler. All roles have now been cast, and casting is officially closed.

We truly appreciate everyone who took the time to audition and support the project. If any future roles become available, we'll be sure to post updates.

Thank you again!

🎬 CASTING CALL – THE WHISTLE

 Im looking to cast the role of Matt in my upcoming independent horror/thriller, The Whistle.

ROLE: Matt (Supporting Role)

Matt is the comic relief of the group—always ready with a joke and determined to keep everyone's spirits up. But when things take a terrifying turn, he has to prove he'll do whatever it takes to help his friends survive.

📍 Filming Location: Lumberton / Fayetteville, North Carolina

📅 Filming Dates: August 29th & August 30th

💰 Pay: $25–$50 per day (depending on acting experience and performance)

Looking for: • Male, 20s–early 30s

• Strong personality and screen presence

• Comfortable balancing comedy with serious dramatic moments

• Acting experience preferred, but not require

Email 

Thewhistlemovie@gmail.com

If you're interested or know someone who would be a great fit, send me a message with your headshot, acting resume (if you have one), and a recent acting reel or self-tape.

Please like, comment, and share to help us find the right actor!

#CastingCall #NorthCarolinaActors #LumbertonNC #FayettevilleNC #IndieFilm #HorrorMovie #TheWhistle #SupportingRole #ActorsWanted

Do ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

-Gangus 1 (30) – napakowany trep 
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Nitrox (33) – Haker z darknetu, który sprzedaje fałszywe dokumenty. Stara się nie wyróżniać
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Tomasz Kubik, ps. Heniek (35)  – brutalny i okrutny facet, bezmyślny prostak. 
Data: 19, 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1800 zł netto za całość

-Barman (36) – szemrany typek, stoi za barem w knajpie. 
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Drogosz (37) – Typ stalkera, ma problemy z nawiązywaniem kontaktów z kobietami, sfrustrowany i z problemami, zdolny do porwania nastolatki. Łatwo się zakochuje i nie odpuszcza.
Data: 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Gangus 2 (40) – dobrze zbudowany kryminalista, epizod bez tekstu. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Sceny: 2, 3, PPS-8
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Mechanik, ps. Radek (45) – szemrany mechanik, który zajmuje się paserką.
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

-Ochroniarz (50) – typowy ochroniarz z niewielkiej agencji. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Tata Kai (50) – Załamany ojciec porwanej dziewczyny. Stara się trzymać, ale mocno przeżywa sytuację
Data: 21.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Łukasz Kruk (51) – Ojciec nastolatka, szanowany prawnik, który za wszelką cenę chce pomóc synowi uniknąć kary. Inteligentny, zna kruczki prawne. Elegancki.
Data: 20 i 22.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Świadek (65) – typ emeryta z małej miejscowości, z psem. Szukamy pana z własnym pieskiem
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

-Ratownik – Ratownik ZRM
Data: 21.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

🎬 **CASTING | Etiuda 3. roku Szkoły Filmowej w Łodzi**

Do etiudy licencjackiej realizowanej w Szkole Filmowej w Łodzi poszukujemy **młodej dziewczyny** do krótkiego materiału stylizowanego na nagranie archiwalne.

W filmie pojawi się sekwencja archiwalna przedstawiająca główną bohaterkę w młodości – do tej roli poszukujemy dziewczyny o blond włosach, jasnej cerze i naturalnym wyglądzie.

**Najważniejsze wymaganie:** praktyka jogi. Szukamy osoby, która swobodnie wykonuje pozycje jogi – mile widziane również bardziej zaawansowane elementy, takie jak np. stanie na głowie czy inne odwrócone asany.

Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne – zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności przed kamerą i swobodzie ruchu.

📍 Zdjęcia: Warszawa/Łódź

📅 Termin: Sierpień

💰 Oferta symbolicznie płatna

Jeśli czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie lub znasz osobę, która mogłaby pasować, prosimy o:
• kilka aktualnych zdjęć twarzy i sylwetki,
• krótki opis doświadczenia z jogą
• krótki film lub zdjęcia przedstawiające wykonywane asany.

Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać w wiadomości prywatnej lub na adres: [j.wasiewicz@student.filmschool](mailto:j.wasiewicz@student.filmschool).lodz.pl

Będziemy wdzięczni za udostępnienia. 🤍

**CASTING CALL – PAID, NON-UNION COMMERCIAL**

Novel Productions is casting **one role** for a 1**5-second commercial** for Applewood Auto Group.

**Shoot Location:** Langley, BC

**Shoot Date:** August 20, 2026 (5 hours)

**Compensation:** $1000 (Including buyout)

**ROLE:**

• **Customer** — Age **25–65+** | Gender & ethnicity open

**SUBMISSIONS:**

Please send **headshot, acting resume, and reel (if available)** to: **casting@novelproductions.ca**

**Subject line:**

*Applewood Casting - Role Name - Your Name*

Usage will be in perpetuity. Additional usage details will be provided to selected talent.

Selected submissions will be contacted with sides and instructions for self-tape auditions.

We encourage submissions from actors of all backgrounds.

**CASTING CALL – PAID, NON-UNION COMMERCIAL**

Novel Productions is casting **one role** for a 1**5-second commercial** for Applewood Auto Group.

**Shoot Location:** Langley, BC

**Shoot Date:** August 20, 2026 (5 hours)

**Compensation:** $1000 (Including buyout)

**ROLE:**

• **Customer** — Age **25–65+** | Gender & ethnicity open

**SUBMISSIONS:**

Please send **headshot, acting resume, and reel (if available)** to: **casting@novelproductions.ca**

**Subject line:**

*Applewood Casting - Role Name - Your Name*

Usage will be in perpetuity. Additional usage details will be provided to selected talent.

Selected submissions will be contacted with sides and instructions for self-tape auditions.

We encourage submissions from actors of all backgrounds.

items.text:
**COLD BLOWS THE WIND**

**Independent feature film — now casting**

Shooting in British Columbia, 15 August – 31 October 2026

Somewhere on the coast of British Columbia there is a cove. In that cove, there is a sailboat called Esperanto.

What happened there is disputed. Two old men will tell you one version, loudly, over the top of one another. A

father tells his daughter a gentler one. A woman writes it all down at night and is not certain she believes a word

of it.

There is a mermaid in it. She is several hundred years old and she likes old black-and-white movies.

We are looking for faces with weather in them and voices with some mileage. This is a character piece before it is

anything else — long scenes, real silence, and very little explaining. If that is the work you like, we would like to

see you.

**PLEASE NOTE: MIRA and LITTLE MIRA are two entirely separate characters who happen to share a**

**name. Little Mira is not a younger version of Mira and is not related to her. Please do not submit for both.**

**ROLES**

**MIRA — female, late 20s to 30s, playing ageless. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

She is several hundred years old and mentions it about as often as anyone else mentions their age. Asked directly,

she lies — smoothly, immediately, and well.

She is not tragic and must not be played tragic. Funny, impatient, jealous, and without a shred of

self-consciousness — she dances when she wants to dance, cooks, picks fights, and is not impressed by anybody.

Charm is the surface. It is not the note.

WATER: strong, confident open-water swimmer. Surf, underwater and cold-water work. Breath-hold comfort

essential. Prosthetic tail and performance work. Freediving, monofin or professional mermaid-performance

experience is a substantial asset — but genuine ease in cold open ocean is the non-negotiable, and it is verified

before callbacks. Please do not overstate it. We would far rather know now.

NUDITY: there is no onscreen nudity. A small number of mermaid sequences are written to imply it and are

achieved entirely through framing, water and camera angle — closed set, discussed in full in advance, covered at

contract. Intimacy in the film is limited and is staged with an intimacy coordinator.

**LITTLE MIRA — female, 7 to 9, to play 8. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

A serious, watchful, self-possessed child. She corrects adults quietly and without heat. She rations her food. She

holds a conversation with a stray dog and takes it seriously. She notices everything and reports none of it.

She is not precocious and she is not plucky. She is a small person with adult composure, doing something

enormous and telling nobody about it.

Much of the part is silent. There are long passages with no dialogue and no scene partner, where the whole of the

scene is a child thinking. That is the job.

No swimming and no water work of any kind. She should be comfortable outdoors — gravel, forest, weather, and

walking real distances.PARENTS AND GUARDIANS: we are looking for a child who is comfortable being quiet. Who goes still when

she is thinking instead of filling the silence. Who watches a room for a while before she joins it. Children like this

get called shy, or serious, or old for their age.

She does not need experience. No class, no headshot, no set. If she has never once considered acting and you are

reading this because something in it made you think of her — that is the submission we want most.

About the material: this is a drama, and loss is part of the story. The part asks for real feeling. There is nothing

frightening or graphic in it. A guardian is with her throughout, every requirement for working with a minor is

provided for, and we will go through all of it with you properly before any of it reaches her.

Maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12. Approximately 25–30 shooting

days, dates to be confirmed.

**ISAAK GREY — male, late 30s to 40s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**LEAD.**

A marine biologist. Sometimes. The rest of the time he disappears into the woods for a few months and comes

back broke — his own line, told as a joke, to strangers, at a dinner table.

Charming, self-deprecating, allergic to his own potential. The kind of man who is right about everything except

himself and would rather be liked than believed. He loves the water in a way he cannot make sound reasonable to

anyone.

Both versions of Isaak need to exist in the same actor already — sharp, well-dressed and sure of himself in one

timeline, holes in his shoes in the other.

The problem to solve: playing failure without apologising for it and without winking at us. He knows precisely

what he is. He simply cannot do anything about it.

A distinctive, characterful profile is an asset. A subtle prosthetic is used in one timeline; a broken nose is not a

requirement. Approx. 11 days.

**THOMAS CAINE — male, 70s to play 75. British character; authentic or exceptional British**

**accent required. LEAD.**

A prospector, a raconteur, and a magnificent bullshitter.

Much of this role is direct storytelling — spoken aloud to a listener, at length, and interrupted at every turn by his

partner of forty-odd years. He preaches, he spits, he does voices, he swears in front of children and gets told off

for it, and he is having the time of his life. Then something crosses his face, the performance drops for half a

second, and he picks it back up and carries on.

The problem to solve: holding a room with nothing but a voice, and letting us see — in one unguarded beat

between sentences — what it costs him to keep talking. This is a stage actor’s part. It wants somebody who has

done it in front of people.

Extensive V.O. as well as on-camera work, including some boat and water work. Read in pairs with WALTER at

callbacks. Approx. 9 days.

**WALTER WEIRS — male, 70s. British character; authentic or exceptional British accent**

**required. Genuinely large build. LEAD.**An enormous man with hands like catcher’s mitts and the gentlest disposition in the film. A former fighter who

spent his career ending other men’s brawls rather than starting them — most of them started by Thomas.

His job is to interrupt, correct and soften. Not for accuracy — for fairness. He loses most of these arguments and

goes on making them anyway. Forty years of partnership sit underneath every line and are never once explained.

Physically large, tall and broad, is written into the character and remarked on by others. Warmth is the essential

quality; the size is only interesting because of the care with which he uses it.

If you have spent a career being cast for your size, this is the part where it finally means something else.

Read in pairs with THOMAS at callbacks.

**DEBORAH — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

A woman who confuses cynicism with wisdom. Quick, funny, socially fearless, and just cruel enough that you

flinch about half a second after you have laughed. Excellent company with a glass of white wine in her hand and

considerably harder to be around at home.

She is not a monster and cannot be played as one. She decided a long time ago that expecting less of people is the

same thing as being clever, and she is quietly handing it on.

The problem to solve: the audience has to like her before they are allowed to be disappointed in her. If they clock

her early, the part is gone.

Partnered with HELEN — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**HELEN — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

Deborah’s partner. Gentle, watchful, nurturing, and considerably tougher than she first appears — she is the one

who laughs a thing away, and also the one who knows exactly what she is laughing away.

The part is small and load-bearing. In a house with very little kindness in it she is the kindness, and she never

once makes a speech about it.

The problem to solve: most of this role is reaction. We are looking for a great listening face — an actress who is

visibly doing something specific while other people talk.

Partnered with DEBORAH — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**COMPENSATION**

$200 CAD/day flat, all roles — leads and supporting alike. Ten-hour days, paid weekly. Non-union.

Milestone bonuses on top of your fee, tied to money actually arriving rather than paperwork being signed. On the

production’s receipt of distribution revenue, a bonus equal to one times your total engagement fee. On

recoupment of total production cash cost, a further two times. Full terms are set out in the engagement agreement.

Little Mira: maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12.

**LOCATIONS**Vancouver, BC (Locarno Beach, False Creek, Vancouver Harbour) · Georgia Strait · Gibsons / Desolation Sound

area, BC · BC Ferry (Langdale route). Some work is outside Vancouver. Travel and accommodation details

confirmed on casting.

**TO SUBMIT**

Headshot, resume, and reel or self-tape link to casting@horstcreative.ca

MIRA — please include a brief and candid note on your open-water and cold-water experience, and any

freediving, monofin or breath-hold background.

THOMAS and WALTER, DEBORAH and HELEN — tell us if you are submitting as an established pair.

LITTLE MIRA — parent or guardian only. Send a recent photo and a short video of her talking about something

she likes. No performance necessary. Please don’t rehearse her or prepare anything — we’d rather see her as she

is.

Sides are released to selected submissions. Full script at callback under NDA.

Self-tapes due 7 August. Callbacks 9 August. THOMAS and WALTER open until filled.

**We would rather see one honest read than three polished ones.**

items.text:
AFFÄRE ODER BEZIEHUNG? EIN DATE, DAS PLÖTZLICH KIPPT

Zwei Darsteller. Drei Locations. Keine vorgegebenen Antworten.

Was passiert, wenn ein scheinbar entspanntes Date plötzlich eine Richtung nimmt, mit der einer von beiden nicht gerechnet hat?

Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße treffen in einer improvisierten Filmszene aufeinander. Ausgangspunkt ist ein gemeinsames Date in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen. Doch irgendwann fällt der entscheidende Satz: Einer von beiden will keine monogame Beziehung, sondern nur eine Affäre.

Improvisation statt auswendig gelernter Dialoge

Wie reagiert das Gegenüber? Enttäuschung, Verständnis, Wut oder vielleicht sogar Zustimmung? Genau das entsteht spontan vor der Kamera.

Gedreht wurde an drei markanten Orten im Kölner Rheinauhafen: in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen, vor dem Schokoladenmuseum und am Kölner Riesenrad. Das Riesenrad steht aktuell direkt am Schokoladenmuseum.

Das vollständige Video mit Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße erscheint bald. Folge uns und entscheide selbst: Affäre oder Beziehung, wie würdest Du reagieren?

#Schauspiel #Improvisation #Darsteller #Köln #Filmproduktion

sharedPost.text:
Glosse: Nur fünfzehn Jahre Verspätung

Fünfzehn Jahre. So lange hat es gedauert, bis eine Frau ihre Würde ein Stück weit zurückbekommen hat.

Das ist doch eigentlich eine beeindruckende Leistung – allerdings nicht für die Gerechtigkeit, sondern für deren Schneckentempo. Während andere in fünfzehn Jahren eine Ausbildung machen, Karriere aufbauen, Kinder großziehen oder in Rente gehen, brauchte die Filmwelt dieselbe Zeit, um zu erkennen: Vielleicht sollte man eine Szene mit einer 13-Jährigen, die halbnackt im Bett liegt und von einem Erwachsenen berührt und geschlagen wird, doch nicht einfach stehen lassen.

Man fragt sich unweigerlich: Musste darüber wirklich anderthalb Jahrzehnte nachgedacht werden? Wurde die Filmszene jedes Jahr erneut in einem Gremium begutachtet? Gab es Protokolle mit dem Tagesordnungspunkt: „Würde – vertagt auf nächstes Jahr“?

Wim Wenders hat die Szene nun entfernt. Das ist richtig. Aber wenn eine Einsicht fünfzehn Jahre Anlauf braucht, wirkt sie weniger wie ein mutiger Schritt als wie ein sehr verspäteter Anschlusszug.

Immerhin zeigt der Fall: Würde hat kein Verfallsdatum. Sie kann ignoriert, verdrängt oder kleingeredet werden – verloren geht sie dadurch nicht. Und manchmal dauert es eben fünfzehn Jahre, bis jemand begreift, dass Respekt keine Frage der Regie, sondern des Anstands ist.

Die eigentliche Pointe ist jedoch bitter: Offenbar braucht es in manchen Teilen der Kulturbranche länger, eine Filmszene zu korrigieren, als einen Spielfilm zu drehen – einschließlich Director’s

🎬 CASTING CALL — CUT OFF
Strong Baby Productions | Filming Location: California | Theatrical Release: July

Warner Bros. Pictures and Strong Baby Productions are seeking talented actors for supporting roles in CUT OFF, a comedy feature written and directed by Jonah Hill. This project features an acclaimed cast including Jonah Hill, Kristen Wiig, Bette Midler, and Nathan Lane.

Project Overview:

CUT OFF follows two affluent siblings who are unexpectedly cut off from their family fortune and must navigate life independently. The film is a sharp, character-driven comedy combining satirical humor with emotional depth.

Supporting Roles Available:

    Dex Fontaine: Male, 30-55. A commanding, deadpan life coach with a hidden warmth.

    Claira Nair: Female, 25-34, South Asian. An energetic, quick-witted neighbor balancing humor and heartfelt moments.

    Todd Blumfeld: Male, 30-42. A smug former assistant with precise comedic timing.

    Grandma Ruthie: Female, 60-80. A warm yet blunt elder with strong stage presence and comic timing.

    Cleo & Marcus: Female & Male (casting as a pair), 30-50. A glamorous couple with natural chemistry, playing cheerfully oblivious socialites.

    Felipe: Male, 45-63, Latino preferred. A wise, warm bodega owner with bilingual abilities advantageous.

Submission Guidelines:

Please submit your professional headshot, résumé, reel or self-tape, contact details, and specify the role you are applying for to (gershangency00@hotmail.com) Submissions from all backgrounds and experience levels are welcome. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We look forward to your submissions.

Seeking San Diego cast for unpaid in-person staged scene reading at Film Net on Sept 8

CASTING FOR UNPAID IN-PERSON SCENE READING in September 

WHERE: FilmNet meeting at Spark Studios in Kearny Mesa - San Diego

WHEN: Tuesday evening, September 8

ABOUT: An "uplifting" historical comedy, inspired by the true story of the invention of the brassiere in 1923. Info: [https://jazzymaemedia.com/abcd/](https://jazzymaemedia.com/abcd/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAYnJpZBExUDBvY1NyUnRYM2NXTkZyQnNydGMGYXBwX2lkEDIyMjAzOTE3ODgyMDA4OTIAAR4MeeqSOEqD-A3dxHvrGjWaNMLRZxS3wRpH1HdkiBR0VCS8ApsJWWknUm30sA_aem_D83GInLe6_kfjMWwe-nxNw)

ROLES:

• JEANETTE: 20s/early 30s - klutzy seamstress, on the short side w/ large bosom, and larger vision 

• RUTH: 20s/early 30s talented beautiful seamstress, on the tall side

• MAX: 20’s/30’s modern sculptor

• MRS. ENRAGÉ: most prudish, outspoken, oldest member of the Ladies' Morality Guild 

• LADY BRIGHAM: grandest and tallest member 

• MRS. SIPPLE: youngest member

Program will be recorded and participants will receive their clips for their reels. 

If interested and available, please DM link to your reel - comedy if you have it – or email the link to info @ [jazzymaemedia.com]

Indie horror film (80s slasher style fun horror)
No acting experience necessary 
Filming Aug 27 Aug 30
Location: Lasqueti Island

Story: Five college friends go away for a weekend in October. They go to the off grid cabin on the island to unplug, play board games, swim, dance have fun.  Little do they know what evil lurks in the woods. Etc. 

20 minutes ready for festivals and online. 

Looking for committed people who are passionate about acting and can communicate effectively via text and phone. 

Please message me if you’re interested. 

Jasper Hodson

Non-Union Casting Call for Short Film “You Are Safe Now”
“A psychological thriller where paranoia and reality become impossible to separate.”

Short Film Logline:

A vulnerable young woman becomes convinced that a group of people are stalking her. Her husband insists it’s the result of her deteriorating mental health. Is she uncovering a terrifying conspiracy—or is she losing her grip on reality?

CASTING FOR TWO LEAD ROLES!

Charlotte

Age Range: 20-30s • Female • Any Ethnicity

Charlotte is a once-promising software engineer whose worsening mental health has left her isolated and working a grocery store job. Intelligent and deeply self-aware, she struggles with growing paranoia while desperately trying to hide the extent of her condition from those around her.

⸻

Lance

Age Range: 20-30s • Male • Any Ethnicity

A successful software engineer who has reluctantly become the caretaker for his wife as her mental health deteriorates. Intelligent and dependable on the surface, Lance harbors growing resentment over the sacrifices he’s made and has begun seeking emotional connection

⸻

Non-Union Casting Call for Short Film “You Are Safe Now”
“A psychological thriller where paranoia and reality become impossible to separate.”

Short Film Logline:

A vulnerable young woman becomes convinced that a group of people are stalking her. Her husband insists it’s the result of her deteriorating mental health. Is she uncovering a terrifying conspiracy—or is she losing her grip on reality?

CASTING FOR TWO LEAD ROLES!

Charlotte

Age Range: 20-30s • Female • Any Ethnicity

Charlotte is a once-promising software engineer whose worsening mental health has left her isolated and working a grocery store job. Intelligent and deeply self-aware, she struggles with growing paranoia while desperately trying to hide the extent of her condition from those around her.

⸻

Lance

Age Range: 20-30s • Male • Any Ethnicity

A successful software engineer who has reluctantly become the caretaker for his wife as her mental health deteriorates. Intelligent and dependable on the surface, Lance harbors growing resentment over the sacrifices he’s made and has begun seeking emotional connection

items.text:
**CASTING CALL - SHORT FILM "FAMILY TIME"**

**Union Status:** UBCP, ULB Under 40 Agreement– Union and Non-Union actors both welcome
**Production Companies:** Wanda Films & Gooseberry Films
**Writer/Director:** Rachelle Younie
**Producer(s):** Rachelle Younie, Maddy Ginn, Kenton Duncan** **

**Synopsis: **At a family reunion hosted by Cathy and Greg in their isolated mountain home, their daughter Phoebe joins cousins Marcus and Darcy and their partners Tara and Simon. When Greg, Marcus, and Simon venture up the mountain with the family dog, Phoebe becomes convinced tragedy is imminent, haunted by the unresolved death of her brother. Hours later, Ruby returns covered in blood, followed by Marcus and Simon carrying Greg's wounded body. As her family collapses in horror, Phoebe experiences an unsettling sense of relief– the catastrophe she feared has finally arrived.

**Shooting Location:** Grand Forks, British Columbia
**Shooting Dates:** September 12-14, 2026
**Audition Format:** Initials via self-tape only, followed by in-person callback
**Self-Tape Submission Deadline: **Friday, August 7, 2026
**In-Person Callbacks:** Monday, August 10, 2026
**Callback Location: **151 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:**
* Rate: $100/day
* All meals provided
* Transportation: Carpool or Gas Reimbursement
* Accommodation: Hotel 
* IMDB credit, demo reel material

**Characters:**
GREG - Man, 55-65, Caucasian, Supporting: Greg is the husband of Cathy and the father of Phoebe. He has little to say to any of his family, feeling like he’s never really known how to be a dad or a member of a functioning family. The reunion ends tragically for Greg.

TARA - Woman, 30-40, Any Ethnicity, Supporting: A reluctant attendee of the reunion, Tara is the new fiancée of Marcus, whose extended family is having the reunion. She only knows parts of the family’s past tragedy, and finds it all very uncomfortable.

**Submission Instructions: **Please submit your resume and headshot as a single PDF document, a link to your demo reel (if applicable), your contact information, and your agent's info (if applicable) to brendan@sadsackcinema.com and indicate which role you're interested in auditioning for. Please label your email subject line: FAMILY TIME – CHARACTER NAME – ACTOR NAME. You will receive an email back with self-tape instructions and sides. Self-tapes due August 7.

Do ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

-Gangus 1 (30) – napakowany trep 
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Nitrox (33) – Haker z darknetu, który sprzedaje fałszywe dokumenty. Stara się nie wyróżniać
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Tomasz Kubik, ps. Heniek (35)  – brutalny i okrutny facet, bezmyślny prostak. 
Data: 19, 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1800 zł netto za całość

-Barman (36) – szemrany typek, stoi za barem w knajpie. 
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Drogosz (37) – Typ stalkera, ma problemy z nawiązywaniem kontaktów z kobietami, sfrustrowany i z problemami, zdolny do porwania nastolatki. Łatwo się zakochuje i nie odpuszcza.
Data: 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Gangus 2 (40) – dobrze zbudowany kryminalista, epizod bez tekstu. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Sceny: 2, 3, PPS-8
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Mechanik, ps. Radek (45) – szemrany mechanik, który zajmuje się paserką.
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

-Ochroniarz (50) – typowy ochroniarz z niewielkiej agencji. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Tata Kai (50) – Załamany ojciec porwanej dziewczyny. Stara się trzymać, ale mocno przeżywa sytuację
Data: 21.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Łukasz Kruk (51) – Ojciec nastolatka, szanowany prawnik, który za wszelką cenę chce pomóc synowi uniknąć kary. Inteligentny, zna kruczki prawne. Elegancki.
Data: 20 i 22.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Świadek (65) – typ emeryta z małej miejscowości, z psem. Szukamy pana z własnym pieskiem
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

-Ratownik – Ratownik ZRM

Szukamy statystów, którzy stworzą nam stała grupę mieszkańców.

Nagrania wrzesień, wcześniej przymiarki

Panowie bez wygolonych boków, zapuszczamy brody, włosy. Panie bez sztucznych makijaży, jenolity kolor włosów. 

Osoby, które nie są wcześniej na mieście lub weselu w tym projekcie.

Zgłoszenia:PAULINA@SCENERIA.COM.PL dopisek POWIŚLE
